$comment: Class links of the CSS Modules components of remark42's Preact frontend (pinned at the same commit as internet-go-remark42, whose smoke entry excludes frontend/**; the Go backend and site are excluded here). Extracted from the sample source by a separate regex pass over every .ts/.tsx file under frontend/apps/remark42/app/components and common (each default import of a relative *.css file, then every styles.x and styles['x'] member whose class exists in that file), and a second pass over className="..." and the string literals of className={...} expressions for the project's non-module stylesheets (a class of a sheet the file imports is an import match, otherwise a name match; the operand of theme === 'dark' is a comparison, not a class, and is not labeled). Both passes were checked by reading the dropdown, spinner, tooltip, avatar, button, root, thread and comment components; not from Concentrate output. Computed members such as styles[position] and the three members of classes the CSS does not declare (auth.tsx:208 form, comment-votes.tsx:61 downVoteIcon, telegram-link.tsx:51 error) are not labeled.
